provenance.selection_rule: Every OSM building whose arithmetic open-ring vertex mean is at most 60 m from the selected driving centerline, estimated by a local tangent-plane projection. Includes footprints not necessarily visible from road.
provenance.limitations: Footprints are map geometry only; never evidence of facade details, accessibility, heights, right-of-way, walkable connection to PV-01, clearances or traversability.
